```plato
//==
// # Collections
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Collections containers
//  - Collections grids
//  - Collections indexable
//  - Derived row access over the IJagged interface
//  - Collections sampling

library Collections
{
    //==
    // # Collections containers
    //
    // Derived functionality for the container-shape interfaces
    // (`collections.concepts.plato`): sub-range helpers built on Slice,
    // self-concatenation, negated membership and key tests, and the LIFO/FIFO
    // conveniences (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abstract_data_type).

    //==
    // # ISliceable
    //
    // Contiguous sub-range helpers built on the half-open Slice(from, exclusiveTo).
    // The end-relative helpers (Skip, TakeLast, DropLast) read Count, which
    // ISliceable now inherits from ICountable.
    // Note: these return the bare interface type ISliceable rather than the concrete
    // implementing type, so chained calls (self.Take(n).Take(m)) resolve against
    // the interface surface and type-check; the concrete type is simply not recovered.
    //
    // `SubRange(start, end)` used to sit here as the endpoint form over a
    // count-based Slice. plato-378 made Slice itself the endpoint form, which
    // made the two identical, so SubRange is gone.

    // The first `count` elements. Precondition: 0 <= count <= Count.
    Take(self: ISliceable, count: Integer): ISliceable
        => self.Slice(0, count);
```
